summary: Phase-4 features (Calculadoras, Plantillas, Favoritos, Dictado por voz) validated end-to-end. 6/6 backend pytest cases pass; all UI flows pass including calculator math checks, template CRUD + 'Usar en chat' with [pendiente] substitution, copy-to-clipboard, favorites (star conv + message), favorites listing/search/cross-profile 403, and voice mic button rendering (Web Speech API available in headless Chromium so mic-button is shown, not mic-unsupported).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_extras.list_favorites has no auth-scoped filter: /api/favorites is global (as spec intends: shared across profiles) and relies only on team Bearer token. OK per spec but worth documenting.
DELETE /api/conversations has no profile_id guard — any profile with the team token can delete another profile's conversations. Spec Phase-4 does not change this; may want to tighten later.

add_favorite always returns the existing favorite when (conv, msg, saver) already exists; this prevents duplicates — good. However there is no soft check that the message belongs to the same profile's conversation beyond conv/profile existence; non-owner saves are allowed as expected.
